Revenue eBrief No. 047/26

11 September 2026

Rent Tax Credit

The Tax and Duty Manual on the Rent Tax Credit has been updated to confirm that the credit is €1,000 for a single person and €2,000 for a jointly assessed couple for the 2026 tax year.

Claims for 2025 can be made through myAccount until 31 December 2029.
